cells.gaps: No fact says how the pilot or the new hospital birth system makes the record, or how many offices use them. Every owner fact is dated 2017 or 2018, outside the 36 months, so owner is left empty; the plan held (GNQ-010, 2022-2026) is the statistics strategy and its passages do not say what the civil registry system does.
cells.note: SIREC is a pilot run in the capital since late 2018, while the regional offices and commune-level judges register on paper: rung 2. CNIAPGE set up a system to register newborns from hospitals in 2025 (GNQ-016), a step forward, but nothing places it in local offices, so not 3.
